description: Full A–Z flag semaphore alphabet reference with every two-arm position drawn on canvas. Searchable by letter or NATO phonetic name.

faqs.a: Each letter is shown as a signaler figure with two arms held at the correct clock positions, plus the position names in text.
Yes — type a letter or a NATO phonetic name (like 'alpha' or 'tango') in the search box to filter the chart.
Semaphore sends letters one at a time with two hand-held flags; positions follow a circle system of eight arm directions.
